storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP Coomer Downloader makes it easy to save all media from Coomer.su creator pages to your computer.

How it works: Navigate to any creator page or post on Coomer.su and click the extension icon. The extension scans visible posts using the Coomer API, detects all videos, images, GIFs, and text content, and presents them in an organized tabbed interface. Click "Download Visible" to bulk save everything, or download individual items.

It handles all media types automatically — videos download as their original format (MP4, WebM, etc.), images save as JPG/PNG/GIF/WebP, and text posts are saved as formatted .txt documents with metadata. All files are organized into Coomer Downloader/{creator name}/{date - title} folders.

Key features:
- Downloads ALL media types: videos, images, GIFs, and text posts
- API-based post scanning — reliable detection of all content
- Bulk download all visible content from a creator page
- Organized folder structure: Coomer Downloader/{creator}/{date - title}
- Tabbed popup interface: Videos, Images/GIFs, Text Posts
- Multi-domain support: coomer.su, coomer.st, coomer.party
- In-page download button on video players
- Download manager with progress tracking
- Dark-themed UI with sky blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to any creator page on Coomer.su
3. Click the extension icon to scan posts
4. Use tabs to browse Videos, Images, or Text
5. Click "Download Visible" or download items individually

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: What types of content can I download?
faq.answer: Videos (MP4, WebM, MOV, etc.), images (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF), GIFs, and text posts. The extension detects all media attached to Coomer posts.

faq.question: How does it find content?
faq.answer: The extension uses the Coomer API to scan posts programmatically. It extracts all attachments, file references, and text content from each post.

faq.question: Can I download from a creator's entire page?
faq.answer: Yes. On a creator page, the extension scans all visible posts (up to 60) and presents all media across tabs. Click Download Visible to bulk download.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: All files save to a Coomer Downloader/{creator name}/{date - title} folder structure inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: Which Coomer domains are supported?
faq.answer: coomer.su (primary), coomer.st, and coomer.party. The extension works across all three domains.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Are text posts really saved?
faq.answer: Yes. Text content from posts is stripped of HTML, formatted with a title and metadata header, and saved as a .txt file in the creator's folder.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
